message.content: Li Hua expresses a very positive impression of the Blood and Wine expansion, describing it as "incredible" and highlighting how the new setting and storyline elevate the game. She particularly emphasizes the beauty of the area, calling it "stunning" and noting that the story feels like a "mini-epic" in itself. Additionally, she praises the character interactions within the expansion, mentioning that the characters are "so memorable." Overall, Li Hua seems to be thoroughly enjoying the additional content and finds it enriches the overall experience of The Witcher 3 significantly.
